pages.text: $(bold)Black Bird Manipulation$(): your eyes take wing, and the bird becomes your body.$(br2)When activated, a $(bold)Black Bird$() (a bat) spawns where you stand and $(bold)your viewpoint transfers into the bird$() to control it directly:$(li)$(bold)W / S$() fly forward/backward $(bold)along your full look direction$() - look up and move to climb, look down and move to descend (to lose height, aim down and press W)$(li)$(bold)A / D$() strafe sideways (always horizontal)$(li)$(bold)Space$() extra ascent (for climbing quickly while looking level)$(li)$(bold)Shift$() dive and self-destruct (no block damage; center damage = (1 + Affinity/100) × (Output × 3 + the Black Bird's health) × 10, radius 3 blocks)$(br2)While the Black Bird is out, your real body $(bold)stays where it was and can still be attacked$(); press the technique release key again to recall the bird and refund half the cursed energy; if the bird dies, your viewpoint returns to your body.
